content: [![Discord 連結至「LopyMine's Project」Discord 伺服器](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d9796c521a3261b9a7e4c3eb6b1c3d2dfe4c112.png)](https://discord.gg/NZzxdkrV4s) [![CurseForge 連結橫幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e867d37a2f6ad224258b75aacf6477e777427717.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/particle-effects) [![Github 連結橫幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae65154a7b076cd508f14975a27d1e75e3449a1d.png)](https://github.com/LopyMine/particle-effects) [![Modrinth 連結橫幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9c43eaea7fc523285ae0981829b84e206672b48.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-effects) ## 💬 描述 Particle Effects 是一個簡單的視覺效果客戶端模組，為原版 Minecraft 中的每種狀態效果添加了獨特紋理的粒子！也支援多人遊玩 ^^ ## ✨ 粒子效果 這裡可以看到每種效果的獨特粒子： ## 🌟 資源包 還有一些資源包可以略微改變原始模組中粒子的外觀。 1) [Particles Updated by zed1ker](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/particles-updated) 2) [Updated Particles by Timofeii7547](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/particle-effects-updated-particles) 3) [Bare Bones x Particle Effects by Dezert3](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/barebones-x-particle-effects)
